svg.title: DIA-005 · A bucket under the leak
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a heavy pipe running across a room. At a flanged joint it leaks, and drops fall into a bucket standing on a dry floor. The bucket stands for published safety research and announced safety policies. On the floor to the right lie a repair clamp and a spanner, unused, standing for liability law, mandatory audits and hard deployment gates.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 5 · HOW THESE INTERACT
the leak: harm, once it shows
It works. The floor stays dry,
and nobody sends for the fitter.
DIA-005 · Shifting the burden: while the bucket catches the drip, nobody is made to mend the joint.
